description: Daily mNAV (market capitalisation divided by the value of the crypto held) for two listed crypto treasury companies, Strategy (MSTR, Bitcoin) and BitMine Immersion Technologies (BMNR, Ether), each with holdings from the latest SEC Form 8-K, estimated shares outstanding, coins per share, the reading 5 and 21 trading sessions earlier and 30 sessions of history. Also returns the current dividend rate, rate history and effective yield of Strategy's STRC preferred stock, with the stated rates and yields of STRK, STRF and STRD. Use this when the user asks whether MSTR or BMNR trades at a premium or discount to its Bitcoin or Ether, what the mNAV is, how many coins either company holds, or what STRC pays. This is market-cap mNAV on common stock, so it reads lower than the enterprise-value mNAV Strategy publishes; the BitMine share count is provisional between quarterly filings. US trading days only, updated after the US close. Not investment advice.

company.description: MSTR, BMNR or ALL (default ALL, which also includes the STRC preferred)
